text:
[LDIA.1.3] A program's **resolved settings** are its dialect's settings
with its `use` block's overrides applied ([LDIA.3.3]). They decide which
constructs the program may use and how the engine carries them out. They
must not change what the program computes ([LDET.1.12]).

The compiler validates every construct in every module of the compilation
unit against the resolved settings. A construct whose capability is `false`
is a compile error at the construct's source location
(`DS_VALIDATE_CAPABILITY_DISABLED`, [LDIA.3.4.2]).

alloy.name: ldia_1_3__resolved
alloy.note: Models resolution and which constructs the settings permit. The clause also says the settings must not change what the program computes ([LDET.1.12]), which the model does not state.
